decisions.decision: Record phase 50b BLOCKED and carry MONO-12 rather than designate an unrelated repo as the adoption target
decisions.rationale: /adopt writes into its target; conscripting an out-of-scope repo is an unauthorized outward-facing change, and a manufactured fixture target would satisfy the phase's own criterion 4 only on paper. Owner chose block-and-carry at the phase boundary.

decisions.decision: Merge tasks 2+3 of plan 50a-01 into ONE atomic task before executing
decisions.rationale: generate.py's validate.check_skill_set raises before any write on a mismatched skill set, so the per-task auto-commit between the absorption and the re-emit would have committed a state that cannot even regenerate. The plan-checker caught that the plan's prose said 'one commit' while the executor harness had no mechanism to honour it.
